1.consolidated_definition: Cuando ha llovido y la quebrada crece, la presión de las aguas se lleva todos los desperdicios que hay dentro del agua y en las orillas. A eso le llaman limpiar la joya.
1.en_consolidated_definition: When it has rained and the quebrada (a small stream or gully) swells, the pressure of the water carries away all the debris that is within the water and along its banks. This process is referred to as cleaning the jewel.
